rules: Every open canonical KA appears in exactly one planned batch.
Every batch has one primary production owner and one cohesive caller or transaction boundary.
Manifest dependencies must be qualified already, in the same batch, or in an earlier planned batch.
Effect-oriented KAs require an owning service, idempotency, and an authoritative receipt before qualification.
Registry membership and direct algorithm tests never substitute for a production owning path.

batches.cohesion: Content-free operational views and diagnostic recommendations consumed by one observability owner
batches.effect_boundary: Pure/advisory; no dashboard, report, alert, debug, profile, or optimization effect may be claimed

batches.cohesion: One ordered secure ingestion transaction from admission through archival
batches.effect_boundary: IngestionService owns the admitted write and archive receipts; all intermediate KAs remain pure

batches.cohesion: Model preparation, feature construction, tuning, and measured evaluation under one lifecycle owner
batches.effect_boundary: Training is service-owned and receipted; evaluation, feature engineering, and tuning remain proposals

batches.cohesion: Version, experiment, compression, and release-preparation proposals
batches.effect_boundary: ProviderModelLifecycleService owns only the release-preparation record; deployment, routing, version registration, pruning, and quantization remain unapplied

batches.cohesion: Temporal decay, drift, scheduling, failure-pattern, and obsolescence maintenance
batches.effect_boundary: KnowledgeTemporalHealthService records verified maintenance-review proposals with receipts; no knowledge, trust, alert, job, version, retirement, or obsolescence effect is applied

batches.cohesion: Candidate context gaps, analytical framing, temporal/jurisdiction context, dependencies, and hypotheses
batches.effect_boundary: Pure/advisory candidate preparation with no external or persistent effect

batches.cohesion: One retrieval decision with provenance, redundancy, importance, and dependency evidence
batches.effect_boundary: Pure retrieval ranking and evidence production; no store mutation

batches.cohesion: Canonical algorithm selection, complexity estimation, intent, reasoning boundary, and controller authority
batches.effect_boundary: Pure fail-closed admission/routing; no provider or persistence effect

batches.cohesion: Adversarial, privacy-preservation, safety, and output filtering decisions at one policy boundary
batches.effect_boundary: TruthGate owns allow/block decisions; the KAs apply no external effect

batches.cohesion: Trust, provenance, integrity, quarantine, and containment admission for knowledge state
batches.effect_boundary: KnowledgeLifecycleService owns quarantine/containment records; no KA directly mutates knowledge

batches.cohesion: Knowledge expansion candidate and its release-gated promotion decision
batches.effect_boundary: Promotion remains a decision; an owning knowledge service must apply and receipt any state change

batches.cohesion: Persona simulation, weighting, viewpoint expansion, conflict resolution, and consensus in one persona DAG
batches.effect_boundary: PersonaContextService alone applies the selected bounded context with one receipt

batches.cohesion: Candidate-tree evidence validation, contradiction, confidence normalization, propagation, imputation, and entropy
batches.effect_boundary: GovernedExecutionService consumes decisions; KAs do not persist or call a provider

batches.cohesion: Reserved-route limitation, clarification, and predictive layer-preemption decisions
batches.effect_boundary: Pure routing decisions; no autonomous clarification or layer mutation

batches.cohesion: Cache, ontology, alignment, lineage, patch, conflict, pruning, and tier-maintenance proposals

batches.cohesion: Distillation, compression, cross-lingual fusion, multimodal integration, and learning proposals
batches.effect_boundary: KnowledgeLifecycleService applies only release-gated content changes with receipts

batches.cohesion: Usage analytics, lifecycle orchestration, policy evolution, and human escalation

batches.cohesion: Loopback, emergence, override-reason, self-introspection, and entropy release oversight

batches.cohesion: Bias, system integrity, truth/utility, capability escalation, and cross-domain coupling gates
batches.effect_boundary: TruthGate owns all fail-closed policy decisions; proposed containment remains unapplied

batches.cohesion: Release authorization and long-horizon goal-drift oversight after introspection

batches.cohesion: Causal, analogical, Pareto, creative-composition, meta-selection, and anomaly decisions

batches.cohesion: Entity extraction, summarization, translation, paraphrase, style, explanation, and identity evidence
